subject.title: feat: add per-agent daily model spend alerts

question: Should OpenClaw adopt a persisted core configuration and best-effort owner-reply notification contract for per-agent daily model spend, including intentionally lossy alert delivery on failed sends?
rationale: The implementation is an opt-in product capability with a new public config surface, persistent state, cost-accounting semantics, and an explicit at-most-once delivery tradeoff; code review alone cannot determine whether that permanent contract belongs in core.

options.title: Sponsor the best-effort core feature
options.body: Accept the proposed informational contract after current-head runtime proof confirms accounting and private-owner delivery behavior.

options.title: Narrow or defer the contract
options.body: Keep the feature request open while maintainers choose a different owner surface, accounting scope, or delivery guarantee before code lands.

options.title: Route it outside core
options.body: Reject a core config/state contract and direct the capability toward an external integration if current plugin seams are judged sufficient.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the best-effort core feature
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed informational contract after current-head runtime proof confirms accounting and private-owner delivery behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor currently owns the proposal and can clarify the intended feature contract, though final product acceptance requires a repository decision-maker.
